note: Reviewed cutoffs. tools/cutoffs.py generates every pair the files can suggest (13238 rows on this install, base game and DLC); tools/review_cutoffs.py applies the review rule and writes this file. `items` are community cutoffs that survived the graph and journal-failure audit; `windows` are journal phases where a connected Failure input gated by the closer's own journal resolves the quest. Only what is here becomes a warning. `decisions` records every kept and excluded family, so the next pass can see why.

pending_review.why_not_shipped: Both 'closers' are early (the prologue follow-up and Destination: Skellige) while q205lofoten is a Skellige quest that comes later, and 2 saves do have it finished. The community is switched off somewhere else in the story too, so the pair very likely reflects a phase transition rather than Yennefer being gone for good. Left out until someone can say which phase switches her off for the last time.

items.action: Finish the Brothers in Arms quests
items.headline: Finish Brothers in Arms before The Isle of Mists
items.why: The Isle of Mists switches off the Kaer Morhen allies' communities in quests\part_2\q402_ciri.w2phase (CDeactivateSpawnset), and every Brothers in Arms quest is played through them: q402nilfgaardianally references quests\part_2\quest_files\q402_ciri\spawnsets\q402_dopey.w2comm; q402novigradallies references quests\part_2\quest_files\q402_ciri\spawnsets\q402_dopey.w2comm; q402skelligeallies references quests\part_2\quest_files\q402_ciri\spawnsets\q402_dopey.w2comm; q402velenallies references quests\part_2\quest_files\q402_ciri\spawnsets\q402_dopey.w2comm. Sailing to the Isle closes them.
caveats: Only two saves in the corpus had a Brothers in Arms quest still open when The Isle of Mists was done; none finished one later. The mechanism is what makes this a cutoff, not the save count.

windows.action: Give both statuettes to Triss during Final Preparations
windows.headline: Hand both statuettes to Triss before Final Preparations ends
windows.why: When Battle Preparations begins, the game's own fixup graph runs a branch for each statuette journal entry: the branch reads q210preparations.journal as Active or Success and sends the entry through a Success or Failure input. That is the game resolving the quests, not an NPC silently disappearing. Triss takes the statuettes during Final Preparations after the Philippa rescue (the statuette phase tests q310_philippa_rescued), so that quest is the last window.
files: quests\bugfixing_phase.w2phase: journal blocks 6832 (noble) and 6796 (soldier) have connected Failure inputs fed by conditions 6828/6800; their shared pause condition 6808 ('q210 preparation complete') tests q210preparations.journal as Active or Success
gameplay\journal\quests\q210preparations.journal is Battle Preparations; its first phase is Novigrad ('Meet Avallac'h on the ship')

quests\minor_quests\novigrad\mq3012_jade_statuettes.w2phase is the turn-in; it tests q310_philippa_rescued and q310_keira_done, and its own phase activates triss.w2comm, so Now or Never's switch is a phase transition, not a cutoff
caveats: No save in the corpus has a statuette still open when Battle Preparations starts, so the save history cannot confirm the window; the game's own connected Failure branch is the evidence.
Before the window the journal can say Active for a long time: the quest is still winnable, not lost.
After the window, if the journal still says Active, the app says CHECK NOW rather than LOST; only a Failed journal entry may be called lost.
